COMPANY

Based in Dubai.
Focused on energy trading.

NBK Diesel Trading LLC conducts diesel and petroleum product trading from Dubai Investments Park.

Our commercial scope covers diesel fuel, refined oil products, and offshore trading in refined products and crude oil. We work with business enquiries from commercial, industrial, transport and logistics sectors.
